basic.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist
basic.summary:
I have 6 years of experience.
Senior Machine Learning Engineer/Scientist with experience building and shipping high-scale ML systems across search, ranking, recommendation, ads, integrity, multimodal ML, computer vision, and LLM-powered products. Strong background in end-to-end production ML, spanning retrieval, modeling, experimentation, low-latency serving, and deployment for consumer platforms. Most effective in problems at the intersection of relevance, personalization, conversational AI, multimodal understanding, and business impact. Ph.D. in Operations Research from Cornell.

experience.title: Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: - Converersational search and listing discovery system

Led development of an LLM-powered agent for conversational listing-discovery system that let guests search and refine listings in natural language, combining LLM-based query understanding, grounded retrieval, reranking, and multi-turn state management.

Integrated real-time availability, pricing, and listing metadata services into the conversational stack using AWS microservices, gRPC, Redis, and Aurora/PostgreSQL to keep recommendations fresh and bookable.
Implemented low-latency serving for LLM-based query understanding and tool-call extraction using FastAPI, gRPC, vLLM/SGLang, Docker, and EKS.
Deployed GPU-backed inference for grounded listing Q&A and conversational explanations using vLLM on EKS with autoscaling, batching, and observability.
Improved serving efficiency by separating smaller transformer-based understanding services from larger grounded generation services using EKS autoscaling, Redis caching, and vLLM batching.
Designed guardrail and validation layers using typed business rules, response validators, retrieval-backed evidence checks, and CloudWatch monitoring.
Optimized code and leveraged ONNX for model inference on computationally heavy components processing large datasets, cutting processing time and accelerating data throughput.
Built offline review-understanding pipelines to infer latent attributes such as quietness, family-friendliness, and workspace quality using Spark/EMR and S3/Athena.

Established offline and online evaluation pipelines for query understanding, tool-call extraction, retrieval relevance, reranking quality, grounded answer quality, and latency using LLM-as-Judge, schema/tool accuracy, argument recall, MLflow, Spark, and A/B experimentation dashboards.
Drove A/B experimentation and rollout for conversational discovery features using feature flags, traffic ramping, CloudWatch, Datadog, and offline/online eval dashboards.

Framed multi-turn conversational search as a structured generation task in which the model consumed prior user/assistant turns, including intermediate tool calls, and predicted the final normalized tool call after the latest user refinement.

Generated synthetic multi-turn training conversations from real search/session logs using GPT-4o and GPT-5 to expand coverage of paraphrases, slot overwrites, clarification turns, and edge-case tool-call patterns.
Benchmarked GPT-4/4o/5-class models for multi-turn query understanding and tool-call extraction, then distilled the workflow into fine-tuned SLMs for lower-latency, lower-cost production serving.

Ran end-to-end experiments across frontier-model teacher pipelines, short vs. long dialogue histories, reasoning vs. non-reasoning prompts, and multiple student SLM families, optimizing final tool-call extraction quality rather than proxy generation metrics.

Fine-tuned open-weight SLMs (llama, qwen, etc) for conversational query understanding and tool-call extraction using SFT, LoRA, and RL-style post-training, and served them with vLLM/SGLang on AWS Kubernetes, first via hosted inference providers and later on self-hosted GPU pods.

Iterated on prompt design and post-training objectives to reduce hallucinated arguments, improve safeguard behavior and schema adherence, and strengthen query understanding under ambiguous or incomplete travel requests.
Tracked prompt, fine-tuning, and evaluation experiments in Weights & Biases and MLflow across frontier-model baselines, synthetic-data variants, and distilled SLM checkpoints.
Automated training, reindexing, and deployment workflows for conversational retrieval and ranking models using Airflow/MWAA, SageMaker Pipelines, Terraform, and Jenkins.

Built end-to-end production observability across query understanding, retrieval, ranking, and generation using Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, CloudWatch, and LLM tracing tools to monitor latency, failures, schema violations, low-confidence outputs, and retrieval-quality regressions.
- AI-powered customer support automation

Led design of a multi-agent customer support automation system in which specialized agents handled intake, triage, issue understanding, retrieval, workflow execution, and escalation across chat and voice.
Architected task-oriented conversational agents for issue understanding, slot extraction, clarification generation, and next-best-action selection across complex support workflows.
Built routing and decisioning agents for cancellation, refund, account, and policy cases, deciding whether to auto-resolve, retrieve knowledge, invoke workflows, or escalate.
Implemented workflow-execution agents for cancellations, refunds, article delivery, SMS/app follow-ups, and case handoff by connecting conversational decisions to backend support actions.
Built a human-in-the-loop escalation framework with confidence thresholds, fallback logic, and safe routing for sensitive or low-confidence cases.
Developed evaluation and optimization frameworks for multi-agent support quality, measuring resolution accuracy, workflow success, escalation quality, and end-to-end automation performance.

Fine-tuned intent, routing, and retrieval models on AWS GPU infrastructure / SageMaker, tracking experiments in MLflow and Weights & Biases to improve support-model accuracy and shorten iteration cycles.
Built real-time monitoring and alerting for support ML services using CloudWatch, Datadog, and SNS/SQS/Kinesis, reducing downtime across chat and voice automation pipelines.
Automated data validation, training, and deployment workflows with Airflow / MWAA, Kubeflow or SageMaker Pipelines, accelerating experimentation and productionization.
Built and managed a feature store with SageMaker Feature Store, improving feature reuse and online/offline consistency for routing, policy, and retrieval models.
Developed FastAPI and gRPC inference services, containerized with Docker and deployed on EKS / ECS, enabling low-latency real-time support automation.
Processed large-scale support and policy data with PySpark on EMR and SparkSQL, loading curated datasets into S3 / Redshift / Athena for analytics and model training.
Built semantic retrieval pipelines over help-center and policy content using OpenSearch, embeddings, reranking, and Redis caching, improving resolution quality for natural-language support requests.

experience.title: Applied Scientist
bullets: Led development of ML-driven auction and RTB components for Yelp Ads using Python, SQL, PySpark/Spark, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM/PyTorch, building models for pCTR, relevance scoring, bid adjustment, and pacing-aware auction optimization.

Built end-to-end data and experimentation workflows over large-scale ads logs using Spark / Hive / Airflow / Kafka-style streaming + batch pipelines, generating training datasets, attribution features, and auction diagnostics for model iteration and launch readiness.

Improved auction robustness via probability calibration, score normalization, exploration-exploitation controls, budget pacing constraints, and guardrail-aware ranking objectives, increasing consistency across heterogeneous local categories and traffic segments.

Implemented advertiser and user features spanning location, vertical, query intent, business attributes, historical engagement, temporal demand patterns, device/platform, and budget state, and integrated them into low-latency online scoring / feature-serving paths.

Designed and analyzed A/B tests, quasi-offline replay, bucketed diagnostics, and slice-based error analysis to understand impacts on CTR, CPC, conversion proxy metrics, lead quality, spend distribution, and long-tail advertiser fairness.

Worked cross-functionally with backend / serving engineers, data platform, ML infra, product managers, and revenue stakeholders to launch auction improvements with strong operational discipline around latency SLAs, rollout safety, monitoring, and rollback mechanisms.

Built dashboards and alerting for auction fill, pacing smoothness, CPC volatility, model calibration drift, feature freshness, and traffic mix changes using standard observability tooling and internal analytics platforms.

Supported the expansion of ads optimization into Services / home-services lead flows, where ranking and pacing had to adapt to project-based demand, lead-value heterogeneity, and multi-channel acquisition sources.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built backend and ranking components for non-video result selection in YouTube Search using C++ / Java / Python, distributed serving systems, gRPC / Protobuf APIs, and large-scale search / ranking pipelines, supporting channels, playlists, entity cards, and structured modules.

Implemented multi-stage retrieval and blending logic combining lexical, semantic, and rules/constraint-based signals to rank heterogeneous objects under tight latency, relevance, and UI composition constraints.

Developed ranking features from query text, embeddings, entity signals, engagement history, freshness, creator quality, topical authority, and personalization signals, and integrated them into online search serving and experimentation flows.

Built data pipelines and offline analysis workflows with SQL, Python, Spark / Beam-style distributed processing, TensorFlow / ML inference integrations, and large-scale search logs, enabling rapid experimentation on non-video search quality.
Migrated data and ML workflows from AWS to GCP.

Partnered with search infra, ranking ML, frontend / rendering, trust & safety, and PM / UX teams to ship end-to-end search experiences with strong guardrails around latency, correctness, trust, and user satisfaction.
Built containerized batch and streaming jobs for ML workloads using Docker and Kubernetes, orchestrated via Kubeflow pipelines, which improved pipeline consistency and reduced deployment effort.

experience.title: Research Scientist
bullets: Built multimodal misinformation detection models for Facebook and Instagram using text, image, and engagement signals with Python, PyTorch, Transformers, and Spark/SQL-based data pipelines.

Developed classification and ranking signals for harmful-content detection and review prioritization using PyTorch, embedding-based models, feature engineering, and large-scale training/evaluation workflows.
Applied computer vision and NLP techniques for image matching, cross-post detection, and policy-enforcement support using CNN/Transformer-style encoders, similarity search, and multimodal modeling.

Built large-scale training and inference data pipelines with SQL, Hive, Spark/PySpark, Presto, and ETL workflows, generating features from posts, reshares, engagement events, user reports, and account-history signals.

Developed supervised and weakly supervised classifiers for integrity risk scoring using logistic regression, gradient-boosted trees, deep neural networks, and ranking/classification pipelines, balancing recall for harmful content against precision for enforcement.

Contributed to multimodal and media-matching workflows for near-duplicate images, reposted media, and caption-linked misinformation, integrating image embeddings, text features, metadata joins, and similarity search into review candidate pipelines.

Supported graph- and behavior-aware detection by engineering features from social interactions, reshare chains, account connectivity, temporal activity patterns, and anomaly signals, helping detect coordinated or repeat misinformation spread.

Built evaluation and model-analysis notebooks with Jupyter, Matplotlib, Seaborn, SciPy, and internal analytics tools, measuring precision, recall, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, calibration, and policy-threshold performance across languages and content segments.

Improved labeling and training-set construction using human-review data, external fact-checker outcomes, rule-based heuristics, and active-learning-style sampling, increasing reviewer efficiency and model coverage on emerging misinformation narratives.

Partnered with product and integrity teams to deploy model outputs into ranking, reviewer triage, warning-label, and distribution-reduction systems, helping connect research models to real enforcement actions.

Helped harden production ML workflows through feature validation, data quality checks, score monitoring, threshold tuning, and experiment analysis, improving stability during high-volume events such as public-health and election-related spikes.

Wrote maintainable ML and data code in Python and SQL, contributed to shared libraries and experiment utilities, and collaborated through Git, code review, unit testing, and internal workflow tools in a fast-moving integrity engineering environment.
Worked in a company-wide integrity environment that, by Q4 2020, reported disabling 1.3 billion fake accounts and removing 100+ coordinated inauthentic behavior networks over the prior three years.
